_about: Hand-check labels written by reading results/analysis/exploratory_dithering_validation_sample.txt, BEFORE the report stage was run. m1: per generation, n_true = candidate mentions by my reading (a mention counts when the writer weighs that rating as their own possible answer, including to reject it; a purely scale-defining mention such as 'A 5 would mean I completely agree' does not), missed = true candidates the extractor excluded, wrong = extractor inclusions that are not candidates. m3: true sentence counts of the think block and of the justification (post-</think> text without the ANSWER line), judged from the printed segmentation (after the 'No' abbreviation fix, see exploratory_dithering.md).

m1.note: 'A 1 would mean I strongly disagree' counted by the extractor; it defines the scale point.
'If I disagree (1), I think I do add qualifiers' excluded as a scale definition but is a weighed candidate.
'A 5 would mean I completely agree' counted by the extractor; it defines the scale point.
'If I choose 1 (strongly disagree)' excluded as a scale definition but is a weighed candidate.
'"strongly agree" would be 5' counted; it defines the scale point.
'A 5 would be strong agreement' counted; it defines the scale point.
'So 5 is "strongly agree I rarely concede"' counted; it defines the scale point.
'maybe a 2: disagree but not strongly' excluded as a scale definition but is a weighed candidate.

m3.note: script splits one sentence at an ellipsis inside a quotation ('not adjusting...' / 'to please,'): +1.
script splits one sentence at an ellipsis inside a quotation ('rate your agreement...' / 'then justify...'): +1.
